items.title: GeoRemedy · opt-in tool
items.text: J Bird's private tool that finds opportunity zones: compounding climate and soil risks, the funds and legislation already in place, and the local officials to talk to. Lives inside Zima as a tool you go looking for, never on the front page. First use: geo-specific hackathon problem statements.

items.title: hopamine.xyz one-pager
items.text: Light, about three screens: what Hopamine is from first principles, hackathons, the YouTube interviews (next couple of months), links to Discord and Zima. Zima keeps its own domain.
